tasks.title: One condition
tasks.statement: Output all customers from Moscow: WHERE city = `'Moscow'`. All columns of customers.

tasks.title: Number equals
tasks.statement: Output the product with id = 5: all columns of products.

tasks.title: Expensive products
tasks.statement: Output title and price of products costing more than 5000.

tasks.title: Not more expensive
tasks.statement: Output title and price of products whose price is at most 1500 (<=).

tasks.title: Strictly less
tasks.statement: Output title of products with stock less than 20 (stock < 20).

tasks.title: Not equal
tasks.statement: Output all orders (id, status) whose status is not `'new'`. Use <> (or !=).

tasks.title: Out of stock
tasks.statement: Output title of products that are out of stock (stock = 0).

tasks.title: Paid ones
tasks.statement: Output id and total of paid orders (status = `'paid'`).

tasks.title: Large orders
tasks.statement: Output id and total of orders with a total greater than 10000.

tasks.title: AND
tasks.statement: Output customers from Moscow who have VIP status (vip = 1): columns name, city. The city is `'Moscow'`.

tasks.title: OR
tasks.statement: Output name and city of customers from Kazan or Tver (`'Kazan'` or `'Tver'`).

tasks.title: NOT
tasks.statement: Output title of products that do not belong to the category `'Groceries'` (NOT).
tasks.hint: NOT turns the condition into its opposite.

tasks.title: AND over OR precedence
tasks.statement: Output title, category, price of products from `'Books'` or `'Art supplies'` that are cheaper than 1300. Without parentheses AND is stronger than OR, so place parentheses so that the price condition applies to both categories.

tasks.title: Precedence trap
tasks.statement: Output title of products: category `'Tech'` AND price greater than 40000, OR category `'Books'`. The condition reads as (category = `'Tech'` AND price > 40000) OR category = `'Books'`.

tasks.title: IN: a list
tasks.statement: Using IN, output name of customers from the cities `'Moscow'`, `'Omsk'` and `'Tver'`.

tasks.title: NOT IN
tasks.statement: Output title of products whose category is not in the list (`'Groceries'`, `'Books'`).

tasks.title: IN for numbers
tasks.statement: Output id and status of orders of customers with id 1, 5 and 10.

tasks.title: BETWEEN
tasks.statement: Output title and price of products priced from 1000 to 5000 inclusive (BETWEEN).

tasks.title: NOT BETWEEN
tasks.statement: Output title of products whose price does not lie in the range from 1000 to 5000.

tasks.title: Dates as strings
tasks.statement: Output id and created of orders placed in May 2024 (between '2024-05-01' and '2024-05-31' inclusive).
tasks.hint: Dates in the format YYYY-MM-DD are compared as strings.

tasks.title: After a date
tasks.statement: Output id of orders created after 2024-07-01 (strictly after).

tasks.title: LIKE: the start
tasks.statement: Output title of products that start with the word «Book» (LIKE `'Book%'`).

tasks.title: LIKE: the end
tasks.statement: Output email of customers ending in '@mail.ru' (NULL will not match).

tasks.title: LIKE: inside
tasks.statement: Output title of products whose name contains the letter «y» (LIKE `'%y%'`).

tasks.title: LIKE: one character
tasks.statement: The _ sign stands for exactly one arbitrary character. Output title of products that have exactly three characters after the word «Book » (with a space): LIKE `'Book ___'`.

tasks.title: NOT LIKE
tasks.statement: Output title of products whose names do not contain the word «Book».

tasks.title: Several conditions
tasks.statement: Output title, price of products in the category `'Tech'` that are cheaper than 50000 and have more than 10 units in stock.

tasks.title: Comparing columns
tasks.statement: Output title of products whose stock is greater than their price.
tasks.hint: You can also compare two columns with each other.

tasks.title: Arithmetic in a condition
tasks.statement: Output title of products whose total stock value (price * stock) is greater than 500000.

tasks.title: Even ids
tasks.statement: Output id and name of customers with an even id (id % 2 = 0).

tasks.title: VIP customers
tasks.statement: Output name of VIP customers (vip = 1) and the registration date registered.

tasks.title: Spring 2024 customers
tasks.statement: Output name of customers who registered from March to May 2024 (registered between '2024-03-01' and '2024-05-31').

tasks.title: A customer's orders
tasks.statement: Output id, created, total of the orders of the customer with id = 5 (customer_id = 5).

tasks.title: Paid or shipped
tasks.statement: Output id and status of orders with the status `'paid'` or `'shipped'` (using IN).

tasks.title: Large line items
tasks.statement: The order_items table. Output order_id, product_id, qty for line items where 5 or more units were bought (qty >= 5).

tasks.title: A compound condition
tasks.statement: Output id, status, total of orders where (the status is `'new'` or `'paid'`) and the total is at least 5000.

tasks.title: IT employees
tasks.statement: HR database. Output name, salary of employees of department 1 with a salary above 150000.

tasks.title: Hired in 2023
tasks.statement: HR database. Output name and hired of employees hired in 2023 (hired between '2023-01-01' and '2023-12-31').

tasks.title: Job levels
tasks.statement: HR database. Output name and grade of employees of level `'junior'` or `'senior'`.

tasks.title: Top students
tasks.statement: School database. Output student_id, course_id, score for grades of 5 in 2024.

tasks.title: Ninth grades
tasks.statement: School database. Output name and class of students in the 9th grades (class LIKE `'9%'`).

tasks.title: Old films
tasks.statement: Films database. Output title and year of films released before 2010.

tasks.title: High rating
tasks.statement: Films database. Output title and rating of films with a rating of at least 8.5.

tasks.title: Genre and year
tasks.statement: Films database. Output title of films of the genre `'sci-fi'` released after 2012.
